variety_description: Average yielding, mid-early maturity, medium tall, long slender variety suitable for cultivation under rainfed lowland conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 2003 for planting in Bangladesh in Aman season as a relay crop with Jute. Photo insensitive, tolerant to leaf blast, leaf blight and sheath blight. High % of sterile spikelet.
